Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to play 1 Digimon card with the [Ten Warriors] trait or 1 Tamer card with inherited effects without returning 1 Digimon card from my trash to the hand?

Card Q&A.a: It means a Tamer card with "Inherited Effect" in its lower text. A Tamer card with a [Security] effect in its lower text isn't a "Tamer card with inherited effects."
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "Tamer card with inherited effects" mean, exactly?

Effect: While you have a Tamer or a Digimon with the [Hybrid] trait, you may ignore this card's color requirements.

[Main] You may return 1 Digimon card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait from your trash to the hand. Then, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Ten Warriors] trait or 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand with the play cost reduced by 4.
Notes: Booster SECRET CRISIS [BT17] Movie Memorial Pack
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
